name: Vit nuoc man
summary: Vịt nước mặn is a brackish-water duck from Vàm Sát, grilled in straw and eaten with a pepper and lemongrass dip. The meat is firm, fresh, and naturally sweet, and low in fat.
origin: Can Gio, at Vàm Sát. Dân Việt, 28 Apr 2024.
howToEat: The story says there are several cooks and that straw-grilling is the best. The duck goes yellow. The meat is soft, fresh, and naturally sweet.
seoTitle: Vit nuoc man — straw-grilled duck at Vam Sat
seoDescription: Vịt nước mặn at Vàm Sát is a brackish duck grilled in straw, firm, sweet, and low in fat.
texture: Firm, low in fat, and soft once grilled.
taste: Fresh and naturally sweet, with a pepper and lemongrass dip. The aroma is what the story stresses.
